Sulfonylureas.  ​The sulfonylureas are insulin secreta-
gogues and promote insulin secretion by the beta-cells of the 
pancreas. First- and second-generation sulfonylurea drugs dif-
fer from one another in their potency, pharmacokinetics, and 
metabolism. Disadvantages of their use include weight gain and 
the potential to cause hypoglycemia. They have the advantage 
of being inexpensive.
